assessment: TDP-43 mislocalization is a key feature of some neurodegenerative diseases, but cellular models are lacking. The authors endogenously-tagged TDP-43 with a C-terminal GFP tag in human iPSCs, followed by expression of an intrabody-NES that targeted GFP to the cytosol. They convincingly report physical mislocalization and functional depletion of TDP-43, as measured by microscopy and RNAseq. This method will be valuable to investigators studying the biological consequences of TDP-43 mislocalization and the methodology is in line with the current state-of-the-art.
